note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; statuses are shown as supplied and no consequence is inferred.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Two identical registry windows: in A every checklist item is received as supplied; in B the third item is supplied as pending, so B's bundle holds one sheet fewer and that row gets a dashed ring. Both slips are printed and handed back.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: four supplied items and the FIRST one pending in B, so B's fan misses the front-most checked sheet and the dashed ring comes first in the sequence; different people and wording.
